label: Retained day information improves total awakening accuracy by explicit controls (inference)
rule: Explicit fair-report conditioning and squared-error comparison
meaning: The day-sensitive expected total squared-error regret is (mon-one half) squared plus one half times tue squared. Monday one half and Tuesday zero have expected total error one quarter, below the best day-ignorant constant policy one third, whose error is one third. Setting mon=tue=r recovers exactly the total-token objective. This is the value of a reliable day distinction inside one accuracy objective; it does not settle the appropriate credence norm when that distinction is absent. Proposed connection to epistemic warrant remains UNBUILT; reviewable synthesis in docs/notes/sleeping-beauty-1401.md.
